description: Beginning of the Menaion cycle, 10 stychera at Vespers even if it is a weekday.

Day of fasting.
Matins: Rite of the Exaltation of the Cross (Not implemented here yet).
Switch to the long scheme of Kathismas (3 at daily Matins, Polyeleos on all Sundays, Kathisma 18 at daily Vespers) starting on the Sunday following September 21.
Beginning of the Nativity fast.
Switch to the short scheme of Kathismas for the festive season (2 at daily matins, no Polyeleos on Sundays, variable Kathisma at Vespers).
Compline: after this day canons are special canons inspired by the Holy Week.
Compline: special canons until this day inclusive. After it, no canons for a while.
1-9 hours: Royal hours (if it falls on weekend, transferred to previous Friday).
Vespers with multiple prophecies. If not on a weekend, also with the Liturgy of St. Basil.
Great Compline with Lytia.
End of the Nativity fast.
1-9 hours: Royal hours (if it falls on weekend, transferred to previous Friday).
Vespers with multiple prophecies, and with the great blessing of the water. If not on a weekend, also with the Liturgy of St. Basil.
Great Compline with Lytia.
Switch to the long scheme of Kathismas (3 at daily matins, Polyeleos on all Sundays, Kathisma 18 at daily Vespers) if this date is before the Sunday of the Publican and Pharisee.
Great Compline with Lytia.
End of the Apostles' fast.
Beginning of the Dormition fast.
End of the Dormition fast.
Day of fasting.
